project.title: CryptoGodJohn's 3 Meme Coins for the Next Cycle

model.title: These 3 CryptoGodJohn AI Tokens could go NUCLEAR in the next 90 days
model.mechanism: A large John face, a finite three-token promise, and three visibly different roles.

thesis_sentences: CryptoGodJohn is back in meme coins, with MANIFEST as the culture bet, YOTS as the AI and Elon bet, and GTA6 as his newest gaming and meme-stock thesis.
Each coin gives Benji a different attention narrative to break down, while MAGA and ASTEROID supply the recent post-to-chart proof for why viewers care what John says next.

audience_orientation.reason: Viewers need to know who John is, why his current meme-coin attention matters, and that this is an editorial roundup of three current theses rather than a static portfolio audit.

items.question: Who is John and why does this channel care?
items.answer: John is a repeat Rubicon subject whose finite-pick videos have worked. His alt @0x0papi is part of the same John source trail in Rubicon's Influencer Feed.

items.question: What are the three current narratives?
items.answer: MANIFEST is the culture coin, YOTS is the AI and Elon coin, and GTA6 is the gaming plus meme-stock coin shown in John's latest disclosed three-position image.

items.question: What kind of list is this?
items.answer: This is an editorial roundup of three narratives John is actively discussing, not a promise of future winners or a forensic audit of every trade.

claim_chronology.subject: CryptoGodJohn
claim_chronology.claim: John is actively pushing three distinct meme-coin narratives: culture, AI and Elon, and GTA gaming plus meme stocks.

checkpoints.counter_search_note: The episode reports John's visible claims and information flow rather than adjudicating hidden portfolio consistency.
The useful confirmation is that John continued publicly developing each thesis.

searched_surfaces: John's own public and @0x0papi buy or ape language

checkpoints.note: The episode does not claim a prior exit or a re-entry for the selected three.
